exposure: early postnatal pulmonary artery pressure (measured between postnatal days 3 and 7)
cohort: Infants born at less than 32 weeks gestation and weighing less than 1500g.
finding: Pulmonary artery pressure exceeding 25 mm Hg in the early days of life was identified as an independent risk factor for moderate-to-severe bronchopulmonary dysplasia or mortality.
